column1: # The per-package floor of the test_weld lint (//:test_weld, tools/build/lint/test_weld.bzl).
# One row per package under src/: <package> TAB <welded test files> TAB <test functions in them>.
# The build fails when a package has fewer than its row. A change that adds tests may raise
# its row; a change that removes tests lowers the row in the same diff, where review sees it.
